```{=html}
<section class="home-section" style="border-bottom:none; padding-top:40px;">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <h2>Open data resources</h2>
      <a class="more" href="/data/ekhi.html">EKHI — flagship resource →</a>
    </div>
    <p class="sec-intro">
      The field's openly accessible databases of radiative and optical property
      data, each maintained by an institution on the
      <a href="/network/index.html">research map</a>. Counts are exact and
      dated; every dataset is traceable to its source publication.
    </p>

    <div class="res">
      <div class="res-row">
        <div class="name"><a href="/data/ekhi.html">EKHI</a>
          <span class="by">Thermomat / UPV/EHU · Bilbao</span></div>
        <div class="desc">
          Open, publication-centred database of optical and thermal radiative
          properties of solid materials: curve-level spectral datasets with
          explicit provenance, machine-readable downloads, and citation tools.
          Described in <a href="https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-026-07083-9"><em>Scientific Data</em> (2026)</a>.
          See the latest entries directly in the
          <a href="https://thermomat.ehu.eus/ekhi">live database</a>.
        </div>
        <div class="facts">
          1 251 curves · 167 publications<br/>
          0.05–1000 µm · counts at 2026-01<br/>
          <a href="https://thermomat.ehu.eus/ekhi">thermomat.ehu.eus/ekhi →</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="res-row">
        <div class="name"><a href="/network/dlr-psl.html">Berlin Emissivity Database</a>
          <span class="by">DLR Institute of Planetary Research</span></div>
        <div class="desc">
          Emissivity spectra of planetary-analog materials (minerals, regolith
          simulants) measured in vacuum, including heated samples for Mercury
          and Venus surface conditions. Supports the MERTIS instrument on
          BepiColombo.
        </div>
        <div class="facts">
          planetary analogs · vacuum FTIR<br/>
          <a href="/network/dlr-psl.html">maintainer profile →</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="res-row">
        <div class="name"><a href="https://speclib.jpl.nasa.gov">ECOSTRESS Spectral Library</a>
          <span class="by">NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory</span></div>
        <div class="desc">
          Laboratory reflectance and emissivity spectra of natural and man-made
          materials (formerly the ASTER Spectral Library), widely used for
          land-surface temperature and emissivity retrieval.
        </div>
        <div class="facts">
          natural + man-made materials<br/>
          <a href="https://speclib.jpl.nasa.gov">speclib.jpl.nasa.gov →</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="res-row">
        <div class="name"><a href="/network/usgs-spectroscopy.html">USGS Spectral Library</a>
          <span class="by">U.S. Geological Survey, Spectroscopy Lab</span></div>
        <div class="desc">
          Reference reflectance spectra of minerals, rocks, soils, vegetation,
          and man-made materials, used across remote sensing and as input for
          emissivity modelling.
        </div>
        <div class="facts">
          version 7 · open access<br/>
          <a href="/network/usgs-spectroscopy.html">maintainer profile →</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="res-row">
        <div class="name"><a href="/network/onera-dota.html">MEMOIRES</a>
          <span class="by">ONERA — DOTA</span></div>
        <div class="desc">
          Thermo-optical properties database capitalizing ONERA's measurements
          of the optical properties of materials, coatings, and paints for
          infrared signature studies.
        </div>
        <div class="facts">
          coatings · IR signatures<br/>
          <a href="https://onera.fr/en/dota/memoires">onera.fr/en/dota/memoires →</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

</section>
```
